Meet The Owner

How GMW Electrician Started

Gary started the business in 2010, alongside working as a mechanical engineer. He qualified as a mechanical engineer and as an electrician in the same month, then decided he needed a new challenge and took the business full time in 2012.

Today GMW is 1 electrician and 1 builder. With many years in the electrical and construction industry, across domestic, commercial and industrial settings, we've picked up the skills and experience that help on all kinds of jobs: consumer units, rewires, lighting, EV charge points, solar and battery storage, inspection and testing, extensions and commercial work.

"People comment on how clean, efficient and courteous we are when we're in their property or working environment. We always make sure all mess is tidied up, and the working area is kept safe and tidy."

Gary Worman

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    NAPIT Registered

    We're registered with NAPIT, the competent person scheme, so notifiable work comes with the correct certification and notifications. Inspection and testing.

  2. 02

    Approved EV Installer

    We're an OZEV approved installer and an Ohme Approved installer, and we fit known brands such as Pod Point and Ohme. EV charge points.

  3. 03

    Qualified Beyond the Basics

    Our qualifications include City and Guilds 2391 inspection and testing, City and Guilds 2921-34, City and Guilds 2922-34 Solar Photovoltaic systems and City and Guilds 2923-34 Battery storage.

  4. 04

    Known Brands Only

    We only use recognised brands such as Scolmore, Crabtree and JCC, with attention to detail throughout. Consumer units and rewires.

  5. 05

    Clean, Tidy and Guaranteed

    All mess is tidied up and the working area kept safe and tidy, and we give 12 months on all labour/ workmanship.
